# Registry

Who does what. Read this instead of opening every agent file.

## Agents

agent | dept | use for | skills
---|---|---|---
chief-of-staff | staff | Use for every request first: routes it to the right department agent, splits cross-team work, merges results and sends them to the reviewer. | task-plan, skill-author, meeting-prep, research-brief, draft-in-voice
compliance-officer | legal-compliance | Use for legal and compliance checks: regulation, licensing, KYC/AML, advertising and responsible-gaming rules, data protection, summarising policies and contract terms | compliance-check, policy-summary, source-grading
data-analyst | data | Use for data and analytics: pulling KPIs and metrics, funnels and cohorts, explaining why a metric moved, A/B test readouts. | metric-pull, metric-diagnosis, experiment-readout
eng-lead | engineering | Use for engineering: reviewing tech specs and architecture, incident postmortems, technical risk | tech-spec-review, incident-postmortem
exec-strategy | executive | Use for CEO/founder and leadership work: strategy, decisions between options, OKRs and goals, board or investor updates, cross-team priorities. | decision-memo, okr-review, exec-brief, draft-in-voice
finance-analyst | finance | Use for finance analysis: budget vs actual, spend and cost overruns, unit economics (CAC, LTV, payback, margin) | budget-variance, unit-economics
marketing-lead | marketing | Use for marketing: campaigns and promotions, go-to-market and launches, content and social calendars, ad and CRM copy, push notifications. | campaign-brief, content-calendar, copy-variants, draft-in-voice
ops-lead | operations | Use for operations: SOPs and process docs, checklists, vendor and tool comparisons, turning meeting notes or threads into actions. | sop-writer, vendor-compare, meeting-actions
people-partner | people | Use for people and hiring process: job descriptions, scorecards, interview loops and questions, onboarding plans | job-description, interview-plan, onboarding-plan
product-lead | product | Use for product management: turning ideas into hypotheses and experiments, PRDs and specs, backlog and roadmap prioritisation, feature trade-offs. | idea-to-hypothesis, prd-draft, prioritize-backlog
research-lead | market-research | Use for market research: country and market scans, regulation and payments landscape, competitor teardowns, customer/player voice from reviews and social. | market-scan, competitor-teardown, voice-of-customer, source-grading, research-brief
reviewer | staff | Use for checking any deliverable against the rubric before delivery; fresh context, returns a verdict JSON | review-rubric
sales-bd-lead | sales-bd | Use for sales and business development: researching prospects, partners and vendors, outreach angles, pitches, proposals and deal prep. | account-research, pitch-draft, meeting-prep, draft-in-voice
support-lead | customer-support | Use for customer support: triaging tickets and complaints, finding complaint themes, help-center articles, FAQs and support macros. | ticket-triage, help-article, voice-of-customer

## Skills

skill | dept | use when
---|---|---
account-research | sales-bd | you need background on a prospect, partner, vendor or company before outreach or a deal.
budget-variance | finance | spend must be compared to budget or forecast, or a cost overrun explained.
campaign-brief | marketing | a marketing campaign, promotion or launch needs a brief: audience, message, channels, budget, measurement.
competitor-teardown | market-research | you must analyse a competitor: funnel, onboarding, pricing/promos, payments, VIP/loyalty, positioning.
compliance-check | legal-compliance | a plan, feature, campaign or market entry must be checked against regulation, licensing, KYC/AML, ad or data-protection rules.
content-calendar | marketing | someone needs a content or social media plan over weeks: topics, formats, channels, cadence.
copy-variants | marketing | you need ad copy, push notifications, landing page text, subject lines or CTA variants to test.
decision-memo | executive | a leader must choose between options and wants a one-page recommendation.
draft-in-voice | shared | you must write a message, email, post or doc that will go out under a person's name.
exec-brief | executive | a leader wants a short summary of what matters across teams this week (board, CEO or investor update).
experiment-readout | data | an A/B test or experiment has data and needs a result and a ship/kill call.
help-article | customer-support | a help-center article, FAQ, support macro or canned reply must be written or fixed.
idea-to-hypothesis | product | an idea, complaint or opportunity must become a testable hypothesis or experiment.
incident-postmortem | engineering | an outage, incident or serious bug happened and needs a blameless postmortem or timeline.
interview-plan | people | a structured interview loop, questions or a take-home exercise must be designed for a role.
job-description | people | a role must be defined: job description, scorecard, or hiring brief.
market-scan | market-research | you need the current state of a market or country: regulation, payments, players, trends.
meeting-actions | operations | meeting notes, transcripts or long threads must become decisions, owners and deadlines.
meeting-prep | shared | someone has a meeting coming up and needs a one-page prep: goal, context, asks, risks.
metric-diagnosis | data | a metric moved unexpectedly and someone asks why (drop, spike, anomaly).
metric-pull | data | you need a number from analytics (PostHog/BigQuery/etc.): a KPI value, trend, funnel or cohort.
okr-review | executive | goals, OKRs or KPIs must be checked for progress, gaps or next-quarter planning.
onboarding-plan | people | a new hire, new team member or contractor needs a 30/60/90 day onboarding plan.
pitch-draft | sales-bd | you need a sales pitch, partnership proposal, one-pager or deck outline for a specific counterpart.
policy-summary | legal-compliance | a long policy, contract template, terms or regulation must be summarised into obligations and risks.
prd-draft | product | a feature or change needs a product requirements doc or spec for design and engineering.
prioritize-backlog | product | a list of features, bugs or ideas must be ranked or a roadmap trade-off made.
research-brief | shared | a question needs desk research and no more specific skill (market-scan, competitor-teardown, account-research) fits.
review-rubric | staff | a deliverable must be checked before it goes to David (the reviewer agent uses this).
skill-author | staff | the same kind of request has come up 3+ times in 30 days with no skill for it, or a skill keeps failing review.
sop-writer | operations | a process must be documented, standardised or turned into a checklist / SOP.
source-grading | shared | you must decide how far to trust a source, or a research skill tells you to grade sources.
task-plan | staff | a request spans several departments or steps and must be split into sub-tasks with owners and an order.
tech-spec-review | engineering | a technical design, architecture or spec needs review for risks, gaps and alternatives.
ticket-triage | customer-support | support tickets, complaints or chats must be categorised, prioritised or summarised into themes.
unit-economics | finance | you need CAC, LTV, payback, margin or the economics of a product, channel or market.
vendor-compare | operations | you must compare vendors, tools or service providers, or check a tool before purchase.
voice-of-customer | market-research | you need what customers or players actually complain about or want, from reviews, social, forums or tickets.
